text: An egg is made up of several parts by proportion of the total egg. The yolk (32–35% of the total egg) is made mainly of lipids and proteins. The albumen (52–58% of the total egg) is made mainly of protein and a large amount of water. The chalaza is made of twisted fibers forming a spiral rope that keeps the yolk centered in the albumen. The air chamber is an empty space at the large end of the egg. The shell is only 9–14% of the total egg and is made mainly of calcium.
